name: Website mockup
promptTemplate:
Create a website mockup that clearly presents the page purpose, content, and primary user action. Build strong information hierarchy, understandable navigation and actions, and a coherent interface. Preserve supplied names, copy, prices, and claims exactly; do not invent testimonials, client logos, metrics, or business details.

Ask clarifying questions to establish site purpose, audience, required content, and visual style. Present relevant UI style directions when available.

exampleImages.alt: Red Kiln ceramics shop webpage with a large photo of two vases and a row of three product cards.
